title: Duopra: From Full-Duplex Conversation to Full-Duplex Agency
title_zh: Duopra：从全双工对话到全双工行动
abstract_en: Full-duplex interaction models exhibit strong conversational agency, enabling natural, low-latency turn-taking, backchannels, and interruptions. However, completing tasks further requires task agency: timely tool invocation and argument revision following user corrections. Frontend-backend agents separate initiation from execution: the frontend decides whether and what to request, while the backend determines how. Execution can be offloaded, but unsent requests cannot be executed, and incomplete ones can misdirect the backend. On Full-Duplex-Bench v3 (FDB v3), most failures of Realtime-Venus-Audio + Harness in our streaming pipeline occur before a domain tool executes. We introduce Duopra, a full-duplex interaction model that learns task execution alongside conversational control. Duopra treats the backend as a tool, accepting a self-contained natural-language request. Direct calls and backend delegation share an action interface and requirements for faithful initiation and correct execution. Its three-stage training combines protocol SFT, full-duplex RL rewarding timely and complete execution, and projector-only repair of talker conditioning after thinker updates. With the same backend, Pass@1 rises from 4.7% to 44.7%; Duopra achieves 47.7% calling tools directly (26.0% after SFT) and 49.3% with a DeepSeek backend. It improves three FDB v1.0 takeover rates over the base model. These results show that task agency can coexist with key conversational agency.
abstract_zh: 全双工交互模型能以低延迟自然轮换发言、即时回应并处理打断，但完成任务还要求模型及时调用工具，并在用户纠正后更新调用参数。在前后端分离的代理架构中，前端决定何时发出什么请求，后端决定如何执行；未发出的请求无法执行，信息不完整的请求则可能误导后端。作者在 Full-Duplex-Bench v3（FDB v3）的流式评测中发现，Realtime-Venus-Audio + Harness 的多数失败发生在领域工具开始执行之前。为此，Duopra 将后端视为接收自包含自然语言请求的工具，让直接调用与后端委派共用同一动作接口。其三阶段训练包括协议监督微调（SFT）、奖励及时且完整执行的全双工强化学习（RL），以及在 thinker 更新后仅调整 projector，以修复 talker 的条件输入。在使用相同后端时，Pass@1 从 4.7% 提升至 44.7%；Duopra 直接调用工具时达到 47.7%，而仅经 SFT 时为 26.0%；接入 DeepSeek 后端时达到 49.3%。此外，Duopra 在 FDB v1.0 的三项话轮接管率上均优于基础模型，表明任务执行能力可以与关键的全双工对话能力并存。
key_points_zh: 瓶颈主要出现在工具执行前：前端不仅要及时发出请求，还要传达完整意图，并在用户纠正后修订参数。
Duopra 统一直接工具调用与后端委派的动作接口，要求委派请求包含足够信息，使后端可独立执行。
三阶段训练先用 SFT 学习调用协议，再用全双工 RL 奖励及时、完整的任务执行，最后仅更新 projector 以修复 talker 的条件输入。
在 FDB v3 上，同后端对比的 Pass@1 从 4.7% 升至 44.7%；直接调用达到 47.7%，接入 DeepSeek 后端达到 49.3%。
Duopra 在 FDB v1.0 的三项话轮接管率上均超过基础模型，显示任务能力与全双工对话能力可以同时提升。
